import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static final long MOD1 = 998244353L;
    static final int T = 14;

    static long mod_pow(long b, long e, long m) {
        long r = 1;
        b %= m;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) r = (r * b) % m;
            b = (b * b) % m;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return r;
    }

    static class LinearRecurrenceSolver {
        static long[] berlekampMassey(long[] s) {
            int n = s.length;
            List<Long> cur = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Long> ls = new ArrayList<>();
            int lf = -1;
            long ld = 0;
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                long val = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < cur.size(); ++j) {
                    val = (val + s[i - j - 1] * cur.get(j)) % MOD;
                }
                val = (val - s[i]) % MOD;
                if (val == 0) continue;
                
                if (cur.isEmpty()) {
                    cur = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(i + 1, 0L));
                    lf = i;
                    ld = val;
                    continue;
                }
                
                long k = (-val * mod_pow(ld, MOD - 2, MOD)) % MOD;
                List<Long> c = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(i - lf - 1, 0L));
                c.add(k);
                for (int j = 0; j < ls.size(); ++j) {
                    c.add((-ls.get(j) * k) % MOD);
                }
                if (c.size() < cur.size()) {
                    c.addAll(Collections.nCopies(cur.size() - c.size(), 0L));
                }
                for (int j = 0; j < cur.size(); ++j) {
                    c.set(j, (c.get(j) + cur.get(j)) % MOD);
                }
                if (cur.size() < i - lf + ls.size()) {
                    ls = new ArrayList<>(cur);
                    lf = i;
                    ld = val;
                }
                cur = c;
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < cur.size(); ++i) {
                long x = cur.get(i);
                cur.set(i, (x % MOD + MOD) % MOD);
            }
            
            long[] result = new long[cur.size()];
            for (int i = 0; i < cur.size(); ++i) {
                result[i] = cur.get(i);
            }
            return result;
        }
        
        static long[] h;
        static long[] a;
        static int m;
        
        static void polyMul(long[] p, long[] q) {
            long[] tmp = new long[m * 2];
            for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
                if (p[i] != 0) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                        tmp[i + j] = (tmp[i + j] + p[i] * q[j]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int i = m * 2 - 1; i >= m; --i) {
                if (tmp[i] != 0) {
                    for (int j = m - 1; j >= 0; --j) {
                        tmp[i - j - 1] = (tmp[i - j - 1] + tmp[i] * h[j]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
                p[i] = tmp[i];
            }
        }
        
        static long eval(long k) {
            long[] s = new long[m];
            long[] t = new long[m];
            s[0] = 1;
            if (m != 1) {
                t[1] = 1;
            } else {
                t[0] = h[0];
            }
            
            while (k > 0) {
                if ((k & 1) == 1) {
                    polyMul(s, t);
                }
                polyMul(t, t);
                k >>= 1;
            }
            
            long res = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
                res = (res + s[i] * a[i]) % MOD;
            }
            return (res % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
        }
        
        static long solve(long[] seq, long n) {
            if (n < seq.length) return seq[(int)n];
            h = berlekampMassey(seq);
            m = h.length;
            if (m == 0) return 0;
            a = new long[m];
            for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
                a[i] = seq[i];
            }
            return eval(n);
        }
    }

    static long countValidNumbers(long x, long upperBound) {
        long cnt = 0;
        String s = Long.toString(x);
        int len = s.length();
        if (x > 0) cnt++;
        for (int i = 1; i < T; i++) {
            long base = 1, num = x;
            for (int j = 0; j + 1 < i; j++) base *= 10;
            for (int j = len; j < i; j++) num *= 10;
            if (i < len) {
                String prefix = s.substring(0, Math.min(i, s.length()));
                num = Long.parseLong(prefix) + 1;
            }
            if (num > upperBound) num = upperBound;
            if (num > base) cnt += num - base;
        }
        return cnt;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        
        long n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        n++;
        long limit = n;
        
        long adjustment = (n % MOD) * ((n / MOD1) + 2) % MOD;
        adjustment = (MOD - adjustment) % MOD;
        
        long result = 0;
        for (long offset = -n / MOD1 - 1; offset <= n / MOD1 + 1; offset++) {
            long cnt = 0;
            for (int d = 0; d < T; d++) {
                long left = 0, right = 1;
                if (d >= 1) {
                    left = 1;
                    for (int k = 0; k + 1 < d; k++) left *= 10;
                    right = left * 10;
                }
                if (right > n) right = n;
                long lastRight = right;
                if (left < right) {
                    left--;
                    while (right - left > 1) {
                        long mid = (left + right) >> 1;
                        if (countValidNumbers(mid, limit) > mid + MOD1 * offset - 1) right = mid;
                        else left = mid;
                    }
                    cnt += lastRight - right;
                }
            }
            result += cnt;
        }
        
        result %= MOD;
        result = ((-result - adjustment) % MOD * MOD1) % MOD;
        result = (result % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
        pw.println(result);
        
        pw.close();
    }
}
